output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is multiplied by 10 ** uint256(decimals), which can lead to a situation where totalSupply is set to a very high value, allowing the owner to issue an arbitrary amount of tokens to the owner's account.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not prevent overflow, allowing the balanceOf[_to] to overflow and become effectively unusable, if the balanceOf[_from] is sufficiently large.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not prevent overflow, allowing the balanceOf[_from] to overflow and become effectively unusable, if the allowance is sufficiently large.
The transfer function uses the unprotected _transfer function, allowing attackers to steal funds by exploiting the integer overflow vulnerability in _transfer.
The transferFrom function uses the unprotected _transfer function, allowing attackers to steal funds by exploiting the integer overflow vulnerability in _transfer.
